items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All five ACs of the P1 spec are covered: seams named SHIPWRIGHT_TEST_*, read only in release_seams.py, documented, inert; L1 per seam; publish guard; offline proof test; AC record unchanged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Malformed seam values raise SeamError and are reported as seam_invalid (create_release, condense, setup-changelog stderr), never silently ignored.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: A prefix that leads with the real gh is refused; fixture notes are refused without the gh seam (marker or fixture variable alone); known limit (.env.local honoured) documented.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Exact default argv asserted, a real stub process exercised, one-place and no-literal-gh scans, offline proof with network-blocking env and fail-in-CI instead of skip.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: gh_command re-parses a tiny env value per call (four per release); negligible.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: release_seams.py sits at shared/scripts top level like repo_identity.py (ADR-045); all new files under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Boundary: env var -> argv of a spawned process, and fixture notes file -> publish guard; probed with a real stub process and a real scratch project through refresh_compliance_docs.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene --diff: no findings (skip is CI-gated by is_ci).
